description: This file contains hooks and utility functions for customizing mkdocs build process, including resolving files, modifying navigation structure, and managing translations and language settings.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File, possibly extended for custom behavior.

methods.name: str get_missing_translation_content(docs_dir: str)
methods.description: Returns the content of the missing translation markdown file for a given documentation directory.

methods.name: list[str] get_mkdocs_material_langs()
methods.description: Retrieves available languages supported by Material theme by scanning template files.

methods.name: MkDocsConfig on_config(config: MkDocsConfig, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Adjusts mkdocs configuration based on detected language and updates site URL accordingly.

methods.name: None resolve_file(*, item: str, files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a file by its relative path, falling back to an English source directory if necessary.

methods.name: None resolve_files(*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves multiple files, handling nested structures, through recursive calls.

methods.name: Files on_files(files: Files, *, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Modifies the set of files that mkdocs will process, resolving theme assets and navigation items.

methods.name: list[Union[Page,Section,Link]] generate_renamed_section_items( items: list[Union[Page, Section, Link]], *, config: MkDocsConfig )
methods.description: Processes navigation sections to optionally rename titles based on contained page source.

methods.name: Navigation on_nav( nav: Navigation, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files, **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Rebuilds the navigation structure with potentially renamed sections.

methods.name: Page on_pre_page(page: Page, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files)
methods.description: Placeholder hook that currently returns the page unchanged.

methods.name: str on_page_markdown( markdown: str, *, page: Page, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files )
methods.description: Modifies page markdown to include missing translation notice unless the page is excluded or is not a translated file.
